# CANDIDATE: RSI_EXTREME_WITH_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When RSI reaches extreme levels (>80 or <20) while price diverges from VWAP (price above VWAP with RSI overbought, or price below VWAP with RSI oversold), a mean-reversion trade offers an edge. This combines momentum exhaustion (RSI extremes) with mean-reversion pressure from VWAP deviation, filtered by EMA ribbon alignment to avoid counter-trend entries in strong trends.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: For longs: RSI(14) < 20 AND price close < VWAP - 0.1% AND the 8/21 EMA ribbon is flat or ascending (EMA8 >= EMA21); enter long at close. For shorts: RSI > 80 AND price close > VWAP + 0.1% AND ribbon flat or descending (EMA8 <= EMA21); enter short at close. Exit shape: Stop at the recent swing point opposite direction (chart-stop), target 1R to VWAP, then allow runner to trail with a premium‑stop of 0.3% if price stays beyond VWAP in trade direction. Regime hint: Works in choppy, low‑trend regimes (VIX between 12‑18) and avoids strong trending days or VIX spikes >22.
